stories.title: Di Battista: "Mi hanno asportato un tumore, ora mi devo curare"

en.title: Di Battista: "I had a tumor removed, now I must receive treatment"
en.summary: Italian political figure Di Battista announced he underwent tumor removal surgery and stated his current priority is focusing on his medical treatment rather than candidacy.

stories.title: Trump, 'da vertici big tech impegno moralmente vincolante su sicurezza IA'

en.title: Trump: 'Big tech leaders made morally binding commitment on AI security'
en.summary: Major technology company executives made commitments to Trump regarding artificial intelligence safety measures, with an agreement to implement self-regulation in the sector.

stories.title: Trump incontra vertici Big Tech su sicurezza AI: "Si autoregoleranno"

en.title: Trump meets Big Tech leaders on AI security: "They will self-regulate"
en.summary: Technology executives met with Trump and agreed to a morally binding commitment to establish adequate AI safety safeguards, with companies pledging robust internal controls.

stories.title: Giallo della ricina: perquisiti gli studi di Gianni Di Vita, sentito tre volte in Questura

en.title: Ricin case: offices of Gianni Di Vita searched, questioned three times at Police Headquarters
en.summary: Investigators searched the residence and offices of accountant Gianni Di Vita in connection with a ricin case. Di Vita, not an official suspect, cooperated by providing a USB drive and two computers.

stories.title: Mosca alla Nato: “Difenderemo Kaliningrad con l’intero arsenale”. Precipita bombardiere russo

en.title: Moscow to NATO: "We will defend Kaliningrad with our entire arsenal". Russian bomber crashes
en.summary: Russia threatened NATO regarding Kaliningrad while continuing military operations in Ukraine. Zelensky announced upcoming discussions on air defense and additional assistance.

stories.title: La minaccia di Putin alla Nato: “Per difendere Kaliningrad siamo pronti a usare l’atomica”

en.title: Putin's threat to NATO: "To defend Kaliningrad we are ready to use nuclear weapons"
en.summary: Moscow sent a formal letter to NATO warning of potential strikes on Western capitals, issued after EU-US military exercises near the Russian exclave.

stories.title: Di Battista torna in tv: “Ho avuto un edema per un tumore cerebrale, a Cuba mi hanno salvato”

en.title: Di Battista returns to television: "I had edema from a brain tumor, they saved me in Cuba"
en.summary: The former Five Star Movement politician discussed his hospital stay in Cuba and commented on current political issues including immigration policy and other matters.

stories.title: Meloni, chiudere i canali con l'Egitto rischia di allontanarci dall'obiettivo

en.title: Meloni, closing channels with Egypt risks taking us away from the objective
en.summary: Italian leadership expressed commitment to investigating the truth about Regeni while cautioning against severing diplomatic relations with Egypt.

stories.title: Matteo Renzi: “Se Conte vincesse le primarie, lo voterei”

en.title: Matteo Renzi: "If Conte won the primary, I would vote for him"
en.summary: The leader of Italia Viva presented his book in Milan alongside the city's mayor, discussing Italian politics and his views on potential electoral alliances.

stories.title: Vannacci, debutto a Porta a Porta: “Futuro nazionale indispensabile al centrodestra per vincere”

en.title: Vannacci, debut on Porta a Porta: "National Future indispensable for the center-right to win"
en.summary: A former general stated that his political movement is necessary for the center-right coalition's electoral success and denied allegations of connections to Moscow or Putin.

stories.title: Vannacci, FnV è indispensabile al centrodestra per vincere

en.title: Vannacci, FnV is indispensable for the center-right to win
en.summary: A political figure argued that his party remains crucial for the center-right coalition, citing regional performance concerns in Calabria.

stories.title: Premier League: “Manchester City colpevole di gravi violazioni per 900 milioni di sterline"

en.title: Premier League: "Manchester City guilty of serious violations worth 900 million pounds"
en.summary: The league has charged Manchester City with major rule breaches allegedly committed across nine seasons between 2009 and 2018. The club disputes the allegations and announced it will appeal the decision.

stories.title: Miart si rinnova e rafforza il suo ruolo internazionale

en.title: Miart renews itself and strengthens its international role
en.summary: The modern and contemporary art fair at Fiera Milano has changed its name and updated its format to reinforce its connection with the city of Milan.

stories.title: Arera, bolletta elettrica +37,3% nel quarto trimestre per clienti vulnerabili

en.title: Arera, electricity bill +37.3% in fourth quarter for vulnerable customers
en.summary: The electricity bill for vulnerable customers receiving standard protection will increase by 37.3% in the fourth quarter of 2026 compared to the previous quarter, according to Arera.

stories.title: Ue: «Al vaglio misure per accessibilità economica dei carburanti»

en.title: EU: "Examining measures for fuel affordability"
en.summary: The European Commission is considering potential measures to support fuel availability and affordability for transport, addressing concerns important to many citizens.

stories.title: Itelyum vara Eco Trieste, unità a propulsione ibrida per raccolta rifiuti navali

en.title: Itelyum launches Eco Trieste, hybrid-powered unit for maritime waste collection
en.summary: Italy's largest hybrid-powered vessel has been launched in Trieste to collect marine waste produced by ships on a national scale.

stories.title: BolognaFiere, via libera all’aumento di capitale da 20 milioni

en.title: BolognaFiere, approval for 20 million capital increase
en.summary: BolognaFiere received approval for a 20 million euro capital increase offered to shareholders at 1.25 euros per share, to be completed by March 2027. The board was also authorized to approve a separate 4 million euro increase reserved for the municipality.
